chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Mansur ibn al-'Abbas, from 'Ali ibn Asbat, from Ya'qub ibn Salim, from a man, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

When Rasul Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was taken, the family of Muhammad عليهم السلام spent the longest night, until they thought that no sky shaded them and no earth bore them, because Rasul Allah صلى الله عليه وآله had singled out the near and the far in Allah.

While they were in that state, there came to them one whom they did not see, though they heard his speech. He said: Peace be upon you, O Ahl al-Bayt, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Indeed, in Allah there is consolation for every affliction, salvation from every destruction, and attainment of what has been lost.

Every soul shall taste death, and you shall only be paid your full rewards on the Day of Resurrection. So whoever is kept away from the Fire and admitted into Paradise has indeed succeeded; and the life of this world is nothing but the enjoyment of delusion.

Indeed, Allah chose you, preferred you, purified you, and made you the Ahl al-Bayt of His Prophet. He entrusted you with His knowledge, made you inherit His Book, made you the chest of His knowledge and the staff of His might, set forth for you a likeness from His light, protected you from error, and secured you from trials. So take consolation with the consolation of Allah.

For Allah has not withdrawn His mercy from you, nor will He remove His blessing from you. You are the people of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, through whom the blessing was completed, division was gathered, and the word came into harmony. You are His awliya'; whoever holds to your wilayah succeeds, and whoever wrongs your right perishes.

Your love is an obligation from Allah in His Book upon His believing servants. Then Allah is powerful over aiding you whenever He wills, so be patient for the outcomes of affairs, for they return to Allah. Allah has accepted you from His Prophet as a trust, and entrusted to you His believing friends on the earth. So whoever fulfills his trust, Allah will grant him the reward of his truthfulness.

So you are the entrusted trust; for you are the obligatory love and the prescribed obedience. Rasul Allah صلى الله عليه وآله has been taken, and he had completed the religion for you and made clear to you the path of deliverance, leaving no proof for the ignorant. So whoever is ignorant, or feigns ignorance, or denies, or forgets, or feigns forgetfulness, his reckoning is upon Allah. Allah stands behind your needs, and I entrust you to Allah, and peace be upon you. Then I asked Abu Ja'far عليه السلام: From whom did the condolence come to them? He said: From Allah, Blessed and Exalted.

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the Household of the Prophet, addressed here with honor and consolation
key_terms.الطَّاعَةُ الْمَفْرُوضَةُ: the obedience that has been made obligatory
key_terms.الْأَمَانَةُ الْمُسْتَوْدَعَةُ: the entrusted trust placed in safekeeping
key_terms.ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ: subject to tasting death; expressing the universality of mortality
key_terms.طَهَّرَكُمْ: purified you; indicating divine purification of Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.عَزَاءً: consolation and solace in the face of affliction
key_terms.عِلْمَهُ: His knowledge, entrusted by Allah to them
key_terms.مَوَدَّتُكُمْ: your love; the obligatory affection owed to them

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the divine consolation and status of Ahl al-Bayt after the passing of Rasul Allah صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the grief of Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام after the passing of Rasul Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and the unseen divine condolence that came to console them. It emphasizes their chosen status, purification, entrusted knowledge, obligatory love, and prescribed obedience, while reminding that death, reckoning, and ultimate return are with Allah.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Moalla Bin Myhammad, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Yaqoub Bin Salim, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘When Rasool-Allahsaww passed away, the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww spent long nights until theyasws thought that there is no sky to shade them nor any land below themasws, because Rasool-Allahsaww had held together the near ones and the far ones for the Sake of Allahazwj. So while theyasws were in that (situation), a comer came to them. Theyasws were not seeing him but theyasws were hearing his speech. So he said, ‘The greetings be upon youasws the Peopleasws of the Household, and the Mercy of Allahazwj and Hisazwj Blessings! In Allahazwj there is a consolation from every difficulty and salvation from every destruction, and recovery of whatever is lost. [3:185] Every self shall taste the death, but rather you shall only be paid fully your Reward on the Day of Judgement; then whoever is removed far away from the Fire and is made to enter the Paradise he indeed has succeeded; and what is the life of the world except for a deceptive pleasure. Allahazwj Chose you all (Imamsasws), and Preferred youasws, and Purified youasws, and Made youasws the Peopleasws of the Household of Hisazwj Prophetsaww, and Entrusted Hisazwj Knowledge to youasws, and Made youasws to inherit Hisazwj Book, and Made youasws a Container of Hisazwj Knowledge, and a Staff of Hisazwj Mighty, And Struck for youasws a resemblance from Hisazwj Light and Protected youasws from the error, and Secured youasws from the strife. Thus, youasws were consoled by the Condolences of Allahazwj. So Allahazwj did not Remove Hisazwj Mercy from youasws and never Declined Hisazwj Bounties from youasws. Youasws are ‘أَهْلُ اللَّهِ’ the Peopleasws of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, those by whomasws the Bounties are completed, and the parties gather together, and the speeches are harmonised. And youasws are the Guardiansasws of Allahazwj. So the one who is in yourasws Wilayah would succeed and the one who oppressed yourasws rights would vanish. (Adopting) yourasws cordiality is from Allahazwj, being an Obligation in Hisazwj Book upon Hisazwj servants who are the Momineen. Then, Allahazwj is Able upon Helping youasws whenever Heazwj so Desires to. Therefore, be patient for the consequential ending of the affairs, for these are proceeding to Allahazwj. Allahazwj has Accepted youasws from Hisazwj Prophetsaww as a depository and Entrusted youasws with Hisazwj friends, the Momineen, in the earth. So the one who fulfils his entrustment, Allahazwj would Give him (Rewards for) his truthfulness. Thus, youasws are the Entrusted entrustments, and for youasws is the Obligatory cordiality and the necessitated obedience, and Allahazwj has Captured (the soul of) Hisazwj Prophetsaww, and has Perfected the Religion for you all and Explained to you the way out (deliverance). Therefore Heazwj did not leave an argument for the ignorant one. So the one who is ignorant or pretends to be ignorant, or denies, or forgets, or pretends to forget, so his Reckoning is upon Allahazwj, and Allahazwj is behind (the fulfilment of) all your needs, and Iasws entrust you all to Allahazwj, and the greetings be upon you all’. So I asked Abu Ja’farasws, ‘From who does the consolation come to themasws?’ So heasws said: ‘From Allahazwj Blessed and High’.
en.sarwar: 18. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah from a group of our people from Ahmad ibn Hilal from ’Umayya ibn Ali al-Qaysi who has said that narrated to me Durust ibn abu Mansur who has said the following.
“ I once asked abu al-Hassan (a.s.), ‘Did the Messenger of Allah receive any authority from abu Talib (a.s.) ?”
The Imam (a.s.) said, “No, but abu Talib was the trustee of certain (items) that he delivered to the Holy Prophet (s.a.) .
” I then asked, “What was the condition of abu Talib?”
The Imam (a.s.) Imam said, “ He acknowledged the Holy Prophet (s.a.) and his Divine message.
He delivered to him the (Items of) will and died on that day.”
